# Resource: tfe_vault_oidc_configuration

Manages a Vault OIDC configuration.

~> **Note:** This resource requires using the provider with HCP Terraform on the HCP Terraform Premium edition. Refer to [HCP Terraform pricing](https://www.hashicorp.com/en/pricing?product_intent=terraform&tab=terraform) for details.

## Example Usage

```go
import constructs "github.com/aws/constructs-go/constructs"
import cdktf "github.com/hashicorp/terraform-cdk-go/cdktf"
/*Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.*/
import "github.com/aws-samples/dummy/gen/providers/tfe/vaultOidcConfiguration"
type myConvertedCode struct {
	TerraformStack
}

func newMyConvertedCode(scope Construct, name *string) *myConvertedCode {
	this := &myConvertedCode{}
	cdktf.NewTerraformStack_Override(this, scope, name)
	vaultOidcConfiguration.NewVaultOidcConfiguration(this, jsii.String("example"), &VaultOidcConfigurationConfig{
		address: jsii.String("https://my-vault-cluster-public-vault-659decf3.b8298d98.z1.hashicorp.cloud:8200"),
		authPath: jsii.String("jwt-auth-path"),
		encodedCacert: jsii.String(""),
		namespace: jsii.String("admin"),
		organization: jsii.String("my-org-name"),
		roleName: jsii.String("vault-role-name"),
	})
	return this
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `Address` (String) The full address of your Vault instance.
- `Namespace` (String) The namespace your JWT auth path is mounted in.
- `RoleName` (String) The name of a role in your Vault JWT auth path, with permission to encrypt and decrypt with a Transit secrets engine key.

### Optional

- `AuthPath` (String) The mount path of the JWT authentication method. Defaults to `"jwt"`.
- `EncodedCacert` (String) A base64 encoded certificate which can be used to authenticate your Vault certificate. Only needed for self-hosted Vault Enterprise instances with a self-signed certificate.
- `Organization` (String) Name of the organization. If omitted, organization must be defined in the provider config.

### Read-Only

- `Id` (String) The ID of the Vault OIDC configuration.



## Import

Resource tfe_vault_oidc_configuration can be imported in the following format: 

```shell
# via <VAULT OIDC ID>
terraform import tfe_vault_oidc_configuration.example voidc-AV61VxigiRvkkvPd
```
